UsageCausalParent.title: UsageCausalParent
UsageCausalParent.description: Causal parent of a usage event: an earlier event in the same usage stream (the W010 shape).

UsageStreamId.title: UsageStreamId
UsageStreamId.description: Opaque usage-stream identity: "stream:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W010 stream grammar).

UsageEventSequence.title: UsageEventSequence
UsageEventSequence.description: One usage-event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per usage stream.
